items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I think one night there they had the Prince of Wales there, you know. He become king afterwards, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think one night there they had the Prince of Wales there, you know. He become king afterwards, you know. And they...see, Mosby's big days was in the '20s. See? After the '30s when...like when Heflin and I took over, the thing would be vacant for a month or two...nobody runnin' it at all, and we go in there, and if we didn't make some money and didn't have no money, we couldn't pay rent, we'd be out, and then somebody else'd try again, and the Depression was on. The Depression started around '28...'29.…
Mosby left right at the beginning of the Depression, right? He left the Alabam?
